answer_1.quote: We propose a new dialogue processing task for addressing conversational contradiction... our work utilizes LLMs to detect and modify potential contradictions in dialogues. ... The framework generates explanations and revised utterances to resolve contradictions.
answer_1.outputs: Detected contradiction labels (yes/no), natural-language explanations of contradictions, and modified dialogue utterances

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L of the generated results. ... We also evaluate accuracy, recall and F1 scores of detection. ... Additional metrics such as BARTScore, MBERT and MBART are reported.

answer_3.quote: Automatic evaluation involves performing contradiction detection again with the best performing model in §4.2 on the modified dialogues, and comparing the change in the percentage of contradictory dialogues before and after modification.
methods: re-run contradiction detection on modified dialogues

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we ask human judges to score explanations generated by each model for randomly chosen 200 test samples based on three criteria following ... i.e. label consistency, fluency, and completeness.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges scored each generated explanation on label consistency, fluency, and completeness.
